title: EZSpecificity input
description: Enzyme/substrate specificity prediction. Runs as a parent job that coordinates docking and inference subjobs. Enzyme PDB files must be uploaded to this job before submission.

filename.description: Filename of an uploaded PDB structure. Validated server-side.

enzymes.description: Enzyme structures to evaluate. At most five per job.

docking.description: Optional docking options, passed through to the container unchanged.
